controlled_burst.activation: all distinct bolts hit OR attributed weapon kill

primary_patch_sources.selected_fact: Adaptive and Aggressive base charge time rescaled to 667 ms; rapid 533, precision 800, high-impact 967 ms.
Aggressive fusion changes from simultaneous pellets to three bursts of four pellets.
Enhanced Controlled Burst improved-duration bug fixed.
Fusion PvE scalars changed again; no old Foundry absolute damage is adopted here.

conflicts: Current Foundry HEAD still has rapid .5 s and precision 23.5/30 s, conflicting with official 9.5.0 base timing. Adaptive uses the official displayed .667 s, without pretending it proves sub-frame timing.
Foundry Aggressive still has seven simultaneous pellets, conflicting with official 3x4. That old pattern is not copied to the adaptive consumer.
policies: Shot progress counts each member once across any targets; threshold crossing activates before terminal completion. IMMUNE and BLOCKED count as a landed hit under the existing grouped-receipt contract; CANCELLED/FAILED do not. These qualification edges need original-game calibration.

Each bolt samples current same-life muzzle, direction and on-use damage. A kill may affect later bolts in the same burst; already launched snapshots retain old damage. This sampling policy needs original-game validation.

A per-weapon .201 s firing buff gates the fixed .2 s scheduled salvo. Stow, detach or failed same-life validation retires remaining members; already flying members continue. The fixed .65 s fire interval prevents overlapping salvos of one weapon. This is a reference consumer, not a general automatic-burst controller.
Skipped members remain unresolved until the explicit 2.5 s group expiry, preventing all-hit activation. Known launch rejection closes a member without refund. Unknown results stop without replay.

Controlled Burst persists through stow but is removed when its source is detached. Timing is sampled on next accepted charge; expiry never rewrites an accepted deadline. Independent charge modifier families multiply (.9 x .625 for Warm-Up).

10 damage per bolt, 20 m/s flight, zero gravity, two-second projectile lifetime, 2.5-second group deadline, magazine/reload and unit projection are synthetic calibration. No absolute D2 damage, hitscan/recoil/spread, stat curve or global PvE scalar is asserted.

Each n/30 second absolute burst offset is explicitly rounded upward to integer microseconds in reference JSON. Generic detached-after retains its exact microsecond contract; original-game frame quantization is unverified.
